dedupe_keys.name: investigation of critical concrete strain in unbonded post tensioned precast rocking walls

description: Investigation of critical concrete strain in unbonded post-tensioned precast rocking walls is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Sriram Aaleti, University of Alabama (ua.edu). This project consisted of large-scale testing of two unbonded post-tensioned precast concrete walls to improve prediction of critical concrete strain at the rocking corners. The data can be used to develop numerical models and further the understanding on behavior of rocking precast walls. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Concrete Strain, Plastic Hinge Length, Rocking Walls, Unbonded Post-Tensioned Precast Walls, Precast Walls. Published 2022-11-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
